$1, no matter how many losses came before it

questions.q: An airport screening test correctly flags 95% of actual terrorists and incorrectly flags 2% of innocent travelers. Out of 10,000,000 travelers, only 100 are actual terrorists. If a random flagged traveler is picked, what is the probability they are actually a terrorist?

You shuffle a standard 52-card deck thoroughly and deal all 52 cards face-up in a row. Which specific final order is more likely: the exact order you actually got, or the deck coming out in perfect sorted order (A♠, 2♠, 3♠, ... K♣)?
choices: The order you got is far more likely, since it looks properly random
It depends on how many times the deck was shuffled
They are exactly equally likely — every specific order has the same probability, 1/52!
The sorted order is far more likely, since a shuffle rarely produces something so orderly
